sam (eng-runtime): yep metrics show KV cache resident pages slowly increasing, fragmentation ratio up to 0.72 and free slab count dropping

```
[2026-04-02T12:01:58Z] cudaErrorMemoryAllocation: out of memory
[2026-04-02T12:02:01Z] runtime: container crash (exit code 137) on gpu-node-17
[2026-04-02T12:02:05Z] allocator: paged-attn slab allocation failed, page_free_count=8, requested=16
```

sam (eng-runtime): that stack matches a slow-creep fragmentation mode: KV cache keeps pinning prefixes, eviction isn't kicking in because we hit a fragmentation threshold rather than absolute free memory
erica (eng-oncall): initial mitigation options: 1) force eviction of older KV prefixes on gpu-node-17 2) drain node and restart containers 3) fallback routing to lower-memory model variants for affected customers

julie (support): telling affected customers we're investigating; CS-1987 asked about SLA impact, they want ETA.
